items.title: Curaçá (BA) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #017/2025
items.en_title: Curaçá (BA) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #017/2025
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Curaçá (BA) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 215,385.96; proposals close Nov 24, 14:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
